newsitem.title: CHINA: China Daxie refinery seeks foreign investor.
newsitem.headline: China Daxie refinery seeks foreign investor.

text.p: China is seeking an overseas partner to invest in an oil refinery project on Daxie island off Ningbo port in eastern Zhejiang province, the China Daily Business Weekly said on Sunday.

Daxie has interested foreign investors since 1993 when the State Council authorised the China International Trust and Investment Corporation (CITIC) and the Ningbo city government to develop the 30 square km island, it said.

The project, including developing the island into a world-class deep water port and international trade zone, needs about $2.0 billion and construction of a five to 10 million tonne oil refinery and auxiliary industries, it said.
The project would be a joint venture with CITIC Daxie Development Co or could be wholly foreign funded, it said.
